tools.name: calculate_loan
tools.description: Calculates monthly annuity payment, total interest and fees, EU/Finnish KSL effective annual rate (todellinen vuosikorko), and statutory KSL 7:8 representative example.

tools.name: check_rate_cap
tools.description: Verifies whether a consumer credit in Finland complies with the statutory interest cap (reference rate 2.50% + 15 pp = 17.50%, absolute max 20%) and annual fee cap (0.01%/day, max 150 EUR/year).

tools.name: compare_lenders
tools.description: Lists Finnish loan brokers and major benchmark banks (including non-affiliate banks OP, Nordea, S-Pankki, Danske Bank) filtered by category and amount, sorted by lowest advertised nominal rate.

tools.name: calculate_consolidation
tools.description: Compares multiple existing loans/credit cards (balance, rate, monthly fee) against a single consolidated loan.

tools.name: get_finnish_rates
tools.description: Returns latest Suomen Pankki Euribor (1, 3, 6, 12 month), Finnish statutory reference rate (korkolain viitekorko), and KSL 7:17a consumer credit interest & fee caps.
